passage:
**Rice harvest of four provinces by season, 2025** (in thousands of metric tons)

| Province | Wet season | Dry season |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Province P | 100 | 60 |
| Province Q | 50 | 70 |
| Province R | 45 | 35 |
| Province S | 25 | 15 |
stem: In which province was the dry season harvest bigger than the wet season harvest?
hints: Look across each row. Compare the Wet season number with the Dry season number.
In most rows the wet season number is bigger. Look for the row where the dry season number is bigger.
Check all four provinces, one row at a time, and find the one row where the Dry season number is bigger.

solution.methodName: Read the title and units, then find the row and column

steps.action: Province P: wet 100, dry 60. Wet is bigger.
Province Q: wet 50, dry 70. Dry is bigger.
Province R: wet 45, dry 35. Wet is bigger.
Province S: wet 25, dry 15. Wet is bigger.
Only Province Q had a bigger dry season harvest.

trapNotes.Province P: P has the biggest wet season harvest (100), but its dry season harvest (60) is smaller than that.
trapNotes.Province R: The two numbers for R are close, but the wet season (45) is still bigger than the dry season (35).
trapNotes.Province S: S has the smallest harvest in both seasons. Its wet season (25) is still bigger than its dry season (15).
